podcast.body: Jake Holmes, a folk singer and later a writer of commercial jingles, originally wrote this song. Jimmy Page heard Holmes perform it in 1968 when Page was still with The Yardbirds. Later, Page reworked the song for Led Zeppelin, leading to a successful claim by Holmes that Led Zeppelin's version was plagiarized. "But before Jake Holmes got into the advertising game in jingles, he was a folk singer and wrote Dazed and Confused in 1967."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
